goal: Read docs/IDEA.md with no history and write docs/BRIEF.md: what this round asks for.

acceptance_criteria.text: docs/BRIEF.md has the sections Asked, Deliverable, Done when, Unclear and Not asked
It restates only what docs/IDEA.md says

decisions.what: Treat the round as a change to the existing app: rule-based archetype detection plus Business and Map layouts, global chart rules in DESIGN.md, and archetype-aware exports
decisions.why: The idea asks only for these changes and says to keep everything earlier rounds built and the business's branding
decisions.evidence: docs/IDEA.md L29: "Keep everything the earlier rounds built and the business's branding; change only what these suggestions ask."

decisions.what: Keep rules R4-R7 out of scope, with the detector built as an ordered rule table
decisions.why: The idea reserves them for round 6 but wants the design to allow them to plug in
decisions.evidence: docs/IDEA.md L8: "Rules R4-R7 ... are reserved for round 6; design the detector as an ordered rule table so they plug in."

decisions.what: Treat no AI, offline, no network requests and no new dependencies as hard constraints
decisions.why: The idea states them up front and lists a no-network-requests test
decisions.evidence: docs/IDEA.md L3: "NO AI, offline, no new deps"; L26: "no network requests"

assumptions: The tests listed in the idea are part of the deliverable
"Explorer" is the existing round 4 dashboard and stays unchanged apart from the global chart rules
open_questions: What counts as the latest full period and previous period when data ends mid-period?
How is the primary numeric or amount chosen?
Which categorical column is next for drill-down, and what happens at the last level?
How are top regions defined for the Map app?
How are column roles (especially I versus C) assigned?
What does the View-as switch show when only Explorer qualifies?
What title and section order do exports use for Explorer?
What hexbin cell size and density visual are wanted?
